name: Kirisaki Tetsurou
source:
Turner Grey is the Grey Surgical Clinic's doctor and director. In 2016, there was a malpractice incident at the Grey Surgical Clinic in which 14 in-patients died. Grey blamed a nurse for the deaths. He claimed that she had mixed up the medications, which had resulted in the deaths. On May 24th, she and her sister were involved in a car accident, resulting in the nurse's death. Some believed that Grey was responsible for the accident.

A year later, the clinic is doing badly. Fewer and fewer people are attending. In desperation, Grey asked Ini Miney (who was studying the occult at college) about hiring a spirit medium to call the nurse's spirit, and Ini recommended Maya Fey, future Master of the Kurain Channeling Technique. He intends to make the nurse take the blame for the malpractice incident by signing a written confession. Grey also wants her to write a statement that her death was due to her own negligence and not due to him.

Grey is the type of person who likes to pass the blame onto others, whether it be his clinic staff or even the TV weather girl. He doesn't care that the nurse had died or even that 14 of his patients had died. He is only upset that she had died before taking the blame. He comes across as a rather irritable and self-important individual. Grey also tended to try and out-compete people. Nevertheless, he is a skilled surgeon and is well known to the public, although that is mainly because of his appearance in various tabloid shows due to the malpractice incident. 

[SPOILER]
Two days before the channeling, Grey bought a pistol on the black market, in case the spirit proved to be violent. Ini was actually Mimi, who had tricked her surgeons into giving her Ini's face. Because of this, Fey's channeling would fail if it proceeded, and Mimi feared that Grey would figure out the truth. 

To this end, with the help of Morgan Fey, she hid in the channeling room, knocked Maya out, and stabbed Grey in the chest. Although severely wounded, the damage was not enough to cause instantaneous death. Grey survived long enough to attempt to shoot Mimi with his pistol, but he missed. Mimi then took Grey's gun and shot him at point-blank range right in the forehead, instantly killing him. 

Lotta Hart's research into him revealed him to have been a controlling man, who would yell at nurses and patients if they didn't do what he wanted. He was also described by Mimi as a "slave driver" who was extremely tough on his staff, frequently overworking them.
[/SPOILER]

[Based on his [URL=http://aceattorney.wikia.com/wiki/Ace_Attorney_Wiki]Ace Attorney Wiki[/URL] page.]
